status: source translation proposal; no replay, refit, or performance recomputation

supersedes.claim: EX01 lacks any recovered causal onset implementation
supersedes.correction: Retrospective birth-relative version remains diagnostic; separate retained continuous-prebirth-v1 supplies 10 exact causal predicates. Preserve both version identities.

supersedes.claim: blanket paired long/short overlays for all hypotheses
supersedes.correction: Rejected. Common admission, disposition accounting and execution/reporting conventions do not require identical orders or extra direction variants for existing directional hypotheses.

supersedes.claim: Any treatment of S00279 size-one flow classes as future-only
supersedes.correction: S00283 size_one_tape_pass.py captures the ONSET GROUP mutations and next displayed level at onset group close. These are causal if exact tape/group/order linkage is available. Future episode end/outcome remains unavailable at onset.

overlay_audit.issue: Context-only model predictions plus identical long/short orders make every ST/FB arm execute the same trial, so order P&L cannot test added model information.
overlay_audit.correction: Retain exact forecast-target scoring for every source cell and make any prediction-dependent trading translation explicit, with source cell and translation IDs.

overlay_audit.issue: Adding paired orders to a source-direction rule duplicates its matching side and creates an extra contrary rule absent from source.
overlay_audit.correction: Preserve source direction without blanket overlays. Only add target-type direction variants when original target has no price direction, and label them new design.

overlay_audit.issue: Original horizon can mean recognition-relative, birth-relative, anchor-relative, first3 barrier, next-burst boundary or terminal lifetime; these are not interchangeable entry+h exits.
overlay_audit.correction: Store original outcome anchor separately from execution entry/exit anchor. Do not schedule an order using future next-burst boundary; reactive known-by exit or fixed alternative is a new protocol.

overlay_audit.issue: INPUT_UNAVAILABLE conflates structurally undefined ratio, missing feed, absent model coefficients, not-yet-known, corrupted source, boundary and no-fill.
overlay_audit.correction: Use one common top-level disposition plus operand-specific reason fields; retain every attempted opportunity and source hypothesis, including false predicates, balanced directions, censored endpoints and no fills.

overlay_audit.issue: Source test folds were cut using eligible labeled cohort size; membership and final coefficients cannot automatically be treated as known live at arbitrary historical time.
overlay_audit.correction: Recorded predictions remain research evidence. A live frozen artifact must carry model version, fit cutoff, train-label known-by, feature-order, imputation, scale, coefficients, intercept. If unavailable record MODEL_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE; no hidden refit.

overlay_audit.issue: Whole-day activity terciles, future seed realization, birth-minus-lead and finalized family labels remain hindsight even with symmetric directions.
overlay_audit.correction: Keep as evaluation labels. Use source causal versions where recovered; any prior-training threshold replacement is a distinct declared protocol, never silently call it the original cell.

overlay_audit.issue: An absolute forecast <=spread must not disappear when translating abs>spread to a trial; probabilities below .5 are also source outcomes.
overlay_audit.correction: Retain both exhaustive condition strata and all forecasts; identical admission and reporting. Threshold is a design choice, not evidence filter.

overlay_audit.issue: Per-rule attribution does not make overlapping windows, nested predicates, shared models, or opposite orders independent evidence.
overlay_audit.correction: Attach shared opportunity/lineage/window IDs; report per rule without pooling as independent trades. Common resource/collision policy must not privilege ranked strategies.

common_protocol.classification: NEW PAPER DESIGN unless explicitly supplied by source
common_protocol.admission: Every source hypothesis and all source cells retained regardless historical sign, weakness, null result or undefined/no-fill case.
common_protocol.ledger: Every evaluated opportunity records predicate TRUE/FALSE/UNDEFINED, operand values and known-by/cursor, input reason, forecast status, order intent, fill/no-fill, invalidation and observed/censored outcome.
common_protocol.causal_rule: All entry operands known_by <= decision; execution earliest platform fill after decision. Future targets isolated from entry feature map.
common_protocol.execution: Use parent common paper execution protocol, with explicit tick conversion and identical cost/fill/collision accounting. Never inherit research midpoint changes as fills.

signed_price.note: Direction from regression forecast is new paper translation unless source trade rule already directs it.

absolute_price.negative: Retain raw negative magnitude forecast in lower stratum; do not abs/clamp or treat negative as short.
absolute_price.note: Both strata retained. Threshold and paired directions are new design; paired returns test conditional execution, forecast scores test magnitude model.

flow_strength_change.target: abs(I_future)-abs(I_now), signed strength change not abs(I_future-I_now)
flow_strength_change.undefined: I_now undefined/zero or prediction zero -> retained unavailable/balanced directional trial; forecast target separately scored when defined
flow_strength_change.note: Continuation/reversal link is new unvalidated assumption; not source price law.

binary_probability.direction: Requires declared mapping from target class to price direction; probability sign itself has no such meaning.
binary_probability.note: No calibrated probability claim for ridge outputs. Do not apply to ST/FB regression output.

nondirectional_state.direction: Use explicit target-type NEW design only, preserve original source condition/state and source outcomes; absent direction remains a recorded limitation until that mapping exists.

FC.clock: family strict-pre; input cutoff both receive time and evidence cursor before family event
FC.original: flow1<0 AND flow5<0 AND flow60>0 AND full_depth>0
FC.exact_inverse: flow1>0 AND flow5>0 AND flow60<0 AND full_depth<0
FC.flow_mirror_distinction: Claude flow mirror recent buy with long flow sell is not necessarily exact inverse with negative full book; Oct18 book all bid-heavy.
FC.direction: source recent-flow aligned response; explicit trade follow-recent translation is NEW unless attached source rule defines entry
FC.missing: zero denominator UNDEFINED, not balanced zero; retain missing family records and missing depth

DP.clock: recognition; completed20 bins ending last_closed_second; known quote group at recognition

features.early: I over first10 of20; undefined if empty
features.late: I over last10 of20; undefined if empty
features.display: same-price group lot increases/removals over5s; price changes counted separately, not attributed fills/cancels

DP.state: both_empty if total20==0; one_half_empty if strength_change undefined; weakening if <0; strengthening if >0; steady if ==0
DP.book_relation: undefined_flow if imb_level undefined; balanced if imb_level*touch_imb==0; aligned if product>0; opposed otherwise
DP.price_relation: same with prior_ticks20; zero class flat_or_balanced
DP.direction: sign(current imb_level), never birth polarity for current-state cells
DP.retention: all states including empty and balanced; preserve separate fresh/expiry/mixed and flow-vanished/resumed versions

OL.onset: current touch lots==1 AND (price changes OR previous same-price lots>1); changed price is NEW_BEST even if worse; same-price reduction is standing
OL.direction: bid side -1; ask side +1 for retreat hypothesis
OL.entry: first completed valid group >= onset+1ms in original synthetic assay; actual platform fill NEW execution mapping
OL.first_end: first later group whose (touch_price,touch_lots)!=(onset_price,1); end<=entry group -> BY_ENTRY retained; bid lower/ask higher retreat, same price recovery, other improved
OL.identity: older_resting default; last matching A fresh_add; M price-change repriced_in; M size-cut size_cut_in_place; C partial_cancel_in_place

buckets.disposition: fill_linked if reductions_fill_linked>0 else unlinked_reduction if reductions_unlinked>0 else no_reduction; all captured only during onset group

OL.leak: Later episode end, lifetime, retreat and next-burst success cannot gate onset; onset-group fill linkage is causal.
OL.known_by: S00279 flow class and next_level captured at onset group close from raw onset-group mutations. Size-one prior_touch is preceding group. Do not confuse these with later terminal reduction outcome.

RG.anchor: source a=t0+60 completed source-second label; event seed including second60 known no earlier than +61 (plus delivery). Source +60 outcome retained as separate convention.

directions.next_seed: polarity if P; -polarity if O; undefined otherwise

RG.pairs: All36 unordered direction-source pairs in all/high_vol/fast_high; no expansion beyond source pair grid.
RG.activity: pre300_volume includes t0-299..t0; low<=whole-day tercile1, mid<=tercile2 else high
RG.hour: t0 UTC hour:14 release;13..20 us day except14; otherwise overnight
RG.outcomes: source fixed net horizons and first absolute3tick move through end; next_pol future scoring only
RG.limitations: Whole-day cuts unavailable live; A-state exact classifier/seed must be bound to retained frozen version. Keep original cells as retrospective labels, new prior-training-threshold versions separately.

cross_map: DP weakening/expiry/fresh/empty state families; separate continuous opportunity identity

features.available: 21consecutive seconds AND last valid quote strictly <decision AND valid quote strictly <decision-21s AND same segment

predicates.flow_vanished: valid AND before_ratio defined AND ratio undefined
predicates.flow_resumed: valid AND before_ratio undefined AND ratio defined

EX01.onset: first true observed second after false/unavailable/gap per predicate; first eligible true is left_censored_onset
EX01.direction: No original execution direction. Follow current ratio is source scoring convention; execution direction NEW design. flow_vanished has no current direction; do not substitute zero or future ratio.
EX01.retention: All active seconds and onsets, zero-next-birth onsets, left-censored starts, undefined direction, flat/nonflat balanced, outcome unavailable, futureflow undefined retained. Keep birth-relative1/5/20/60 diagnostic source version separately.
EX01.future_labels: births_in_next60 and birth_at_same_ns isolated from causal features, no gating; links [birth-60,birth) diagnostic only

R.boundary: R1-R10 rule wrappers are separate from ST/FB original regressions. M0/M1 are not ST baseline/full. Copy global model feature/scale/coefficients contract as well as strategy subobject. Existing explicit rule direction, stop, confirmation and invalidation take precedence over generic overlays.
R.known_by: R2 later confirmation must not be backdated to initial T/A; delayed R4/R5 evaluation and anchor20 exit must preserve original clocks; expiry flips distinct from native-flow reversals.

unresolved: Exact future deployment coefficients are not reconstructed by this audit; retained research predictions are not automatically frozen live models.
Other EX subfamilies retain prior review source maps; this follow-up adds exact continuous version only.
Full source hypotheses beyond targeted October families belong to parent catalog; do not interpret this scoped recipe inventory as universal completeness.

method_content.fit: Ridge alpha 10; train-only mean imputation, missingness flags and scaling. Expanding 40/60/80 percent cuts; label purge plus 600-second embargo. Same eligible rows in every arm within target/fold; no search for hyperparameters.
method_content.interpretation: Compare added layers and full-stack ablations; complementary stories do not automatically imply additional predictive value.
limits: Repeated/overlapping observations; interval clusters reported, no iid significance or calibrated probabilities.
Same-price displayed additions/removals are aggregate changes, not proven same-order replenishment or executed absorption.
Fresh and dipole features share trade observations; redundancy correlations and ablations retain this.
Flow-strength target excludes undefined endpoint/start ratios; report empty flow separately.
No future family, birth polarity, final duration, identity, timestamp or source cursor is a predictor.
Price response is a separate target; no universal law or execution rule is admitted.
Each date is discovery; same model and folds, separately fitted. All hypotheses retained for paper comparison.

ST_inventory.fit: Train mean impute, all-missing mean0; missing flags on every feature; train standardize std0->1; alpha10 centered ridge; strict train_time+(h+600)s<test_start; chronological40/60/80%cuts; target-valid rows same across arms. No probability or live deployment artifact implied.
